reason: The story scope is small (3 files, ~20-30 lines of changes, 10 story points, low effort) and the ACs are extremely specific and non-contradictory — they prescribe exact field names, forbid specific anti-patterns, name exact file paths, and include verbatim prior rejection feedback. The timeout was caused by a broken self-healing loop: (1) the FailureAnalyst gave a backwards diagnosis (saying 'preview_token instead of management_token' is wrong, when the AC explicitly mandates preview_token), which was injected into retries and confused the model; (2) the HealingBroken log confirms this same incorrect diagnosis recurred 4+ times without a different fix, meaning the healing system was stuck cycling bad guidance; (3) the prompt grew to 40K chars requiring trimming; (4) the agent did produce verified deliverables but failed tsc on a Query|Entry union type issue in setCommonConfig that a competent model could fix in one pass. No scope restructuring would fix any of these — the problem is the healing-loop diagnosis quality and model capability, not the story's requirements.
